section_title: Thành ngữ ① Tính khí, tâm hồn, tâm trạng
meaning_vi: Hồi hộp, náo nức, lòng rộn ràng
meaning_en: to feel excited, to have one's heart racing

example.jp: 初めての海外旅行に、胸をはずませて出発した。
example.en: I set off with my heart racing for my first trip abroad.

meaning_vi: Lo lắng, bận tâm, đau đầu
meaning_en: to have a headache about, to be troubled by

example.jp: 来月の資金繰りのことを考えると、頭が痛い。
example.en: Thinking about next month's cash flow gives me a real headache.

example.jp: 彼は頭が固くて、新しいやり方を受け入れない。
example.en: He is stubborn and won't accept new ways of doing things.

meaning_vi: Bực mình, phát cáu, xóc óc
meaning_en: to get angry, to be furious

example.jp: 待ち合わせに一時間も遅れてきて、本当に頭にきた。
example.en: Being an hour late to our meeting place really made me furious.

meaning_vi: Khâm phục, kính trọng, cúi đầu

example.jp: 彼女の献身的な介護に、思わず頭が下がった。
example.en: I was deeply humbled by her devoted caregiving.

example.jp: あの人は業界で顔が広く、誰でも紹介してくれる。
example.en: That person has wide connections in the industry and can introduce you to anyone.

meaning_vi: Xuất hiện, ló mặt, có mặt
meaning_en: to show up, to make an appearance

example.jp: 久しぶりに同窓会に顔を出してみた。
example.en: I showed my face at the alumni reunion for the first time in a while.

meaning_en: to be crazy about, to have a weakness for

example.jp: 彼はケーキに目がなくて、見るたびに食べてしまう。
example.en: He has a weakness for cake and eats it every time he sees it.

example.jp: 子どもが小さいうちは、ちょっとも目が離せない。
example.en: When children are small, you can't take your eyes off them for a second.

seg.t: さいうちは、ちょっとも

meaning_vi: Hoa mắt, tối mắt tối mũi

example.jp: 忙しくて目が回るような毎日が続いている。
example.en: Hectic days where my head is spinning continue one after another.

meaning_vi: Hiện lên trước mắt, nhớ đến
meaning_en: to come to mind, to visualize

example.jp: 故郷の山の景色が、今でも目に浮かぶ。
example.en: The scenery of the mountains in my hometown still floats before my eyes.

example.jp: 最近、街でその広告を目にする機会が増えた。
example.en: Lately I've had more chances to see that advertisement around town.

meaning_vi: Đúng tầm nhìn, đúng tầm mắt
meaning_en: to catch one's eye, to be noticeable

example.jp: 部屋に入ると、派手な絵がすぐ目に付いた。
example.en: When I entered the room, the flashy painting caught my eye right away.

example.jp: 成績表を見て、あまりの高得点に目を疑った。
example.en: Looking at the report card, I couldn't believe my eyes at such a high score.

example.jp: 環境問題にもっと目を向けるべき時代だ。
example.en: This is an era when we should pay more attention to environmental issues.

meaning_vi: Nhìn qua, xem qua, lướt mắt
meaning_en: to look over, to glance through

example.jp: 会議の前に必ず資料に目を通しておく。
example.en: I always look through the materials before meetings.

meaning_en: to be embarrassed, to hit too close to home

example.jp: 「もっと努力しなさい」という言葉は耳が痛い。
example.en: The words 'You should try harder' hit a bit too close to home.

example.jp: 祖父は最近耳が遠くなって、大きな声で話す必要がある。
example.en: My grandfather has become hard of hearing lately and I need to speak loudly.

meaning_en: to hear, to come to one's ears

example.jp: その噂は先週から何度も耳にしている。
example.en: I've been hearing that rumor many times since last week.

example.jp: 彼女の悩みに、真剣に耳を傾けた。
example.en: I listened carefully to her worries with sincerity.

meaning_en: to not believe what one hears

example.jp: 突然の解雇通告に、耳を疑った。
example.en: I couldn't believe my ears at the sudden dismissal notice.

meaning_vi: Khéo ăn nói, dẻo mồm dẻo miệng
meaning_en: to be smooth-talking, to be eloquent

example.jp: 彼は口がうまくて、どんな人でも説得できる。
example.en: He has a silver tongue and can persuade anyone.

example.jp: 彼女は口が堅くて、秘密を絶対に漏らさない。
example.en: She is tight-lipped and never reveals secrets.

example.jp: あの人は口が軽いから、大事な話はしない方がいい。
example.en: That person is loose-lipped so it's better not to tell them anything important.

example.jp: 彼は口が重いタイプで、自分のことをあまり話さない。
example.en: He is the quiet type and doesn't talk much about himself.

meaning_en: to say something one shouldn't, to let slip

example.jp: つい口が滑って、驚きを隠せなかった。
example.en: I let slip something by accident and couldn't hide my surprise.

example.jp: 彼は口が悪いが、根はいい人だと思う。
example.en: He has a sharp tongue, but I think he's a good person at heart.

example.jp: あの映画の感想を口にする気になれない。
example.en: I don't feel like voicing my thoughts about that movie.

example.jp: このスープはお口に合いましたでしょうか。
example.en: I hope this soup is to your taste.

meaning_vi: Chen vào, dính vào, cắt ngang

example.jp: 他人の仕事にいちいち口を出すのはよくない。
example.en: It's not good to interfere in other people's work at every turn.

example.jp: 今、両手がふさがっているので、ドアを開けてください。
example.en: My hands are full right now, so please open the door.

seg.t: がふさがっているので、ドアを

meaning_en: to have free time, to be unoccupied

example.jp: 手が空いたら、こちらの書類もお願いします。
example.en: When you have a free moment, please take care of these documents too.

meaning_en: to require a lot of effort

example.jp: このプロジェクトは思ったより手がかかる。
example.en: This project takes more effort than I thought.

meaning_vi: Đang dở tay, không thể rời
meaning_en: to be busy, to be in the middle of something

example.jp: 今は手が離せないので、後で電話します。
example.en: I can't break away right now, so I'll call you later.

example.jp: その限定品をやっと手に入れることができた。
example.en: I was finally able to get hold of that limited-edition item.

meaning_vi: Cầm lên, giành lên, đạt được
meaning_en: to take in hand, to obtain

example.jp: 念願の優勝トロフィーをついに手にした。
example.en: I finally got my hands on the long-awaited championship trophy.

meaning_vi: Không hứng thú, không tập trung

example.jp: 試験の結果が気になって、仕事が手につかない。
example.en: I'm so worried about the exam results that I can't concentrate on work.

example.jp: 課題が多すぎて、どこから手をつければいいか分からない。
example.en: There are so many assignments that I don't know where to start.

meaning_vi: Cho mượn đỡ một tay, giúp đỡ
meaning_en: to lend a hand, to help

example.jp: 困っている人がいたら、積極的に手を貸したい。
example.en: If someone is in trouble, I want to actively lend a hand.

meaning_en: to take a break from work

example.jp: 少し手を休めて、お茶でも飲みましょう。
example.en: Let's take a short break and have some tea.

meaning_vi: Chiếu lệ, qua loa, nơi tay
meaning_en: to cut corners, to slack off

example.jp: どんな仕事でも、手を抜かずに取り組むべきだ。
example.en: You should tackle any job without cutting corners.

example.jp: あの職人は腕がよくて、注文が絶えない。
example.en: That craftsman is highly skilled and orders never stop coming in.

meaning_vi: Luyện tay nghề, nâng cao kỹ năng

example.jp: プロになるために毎日腕を磨いている。
example.en: I am honing my skills every day to become a professional.

meaning_vi: Tay nghề, trình độ tăng cao

example.jp: 毎日練習したおかげで、料理の腕が上がった。
example.en: Thanks to practicing every day, my cooking skills have improved.

meaning_vi: Buông xuôi hai vai, thất vọng
meaning_en: to be disappointed, to hang one's head

example.jp: 試験に落ちて、彼女は肩を落として家に帰った。
example.en: She went home with slumped shoulders after failing the exam.

meaning_vi: Tức giận, bụng tức anh ách

example.jp: 約束を無視されると、どうしても腹が立つ。
example.en: When someone ignores a promise, I inevitably get angry.

example.jp: 彼のおかしな話に、みんなで腹を抱えて笑った。
example.en: We all doubled over with laughter at his funny story.

meaning_vi: Đi quá giới hạn, quá độ

example.jp: 旅行の予算をオーバーして、少し足が出た。
example.en: We went slightly over the travel budget.

meaning_en: to stretch one's legs, to go a little further

example.jp: 京都に来たついでに、奈良まで足を伸ばした。
example.en: While I was in Kyoto, I made a side trip all the way to Nara.

meaning_en: to make a trip, to go somewhere

example.jp: わざわざ遠くまで足を運んでくださり、ありがとうございます。
example.en: Thank you for taking the trouble to come all this way.

seg.t: んでくださり、ありがとうございます。

example.jp: チームの足を引っ張らないよう、一生懸命頑張る。
example.en: I'll do my best so as not to hold the team back.

meaning_vi: Cách này hay cách khác, gì thì gì, kiểu gì cũng
meaning_en: in various ways, one thing or another

example.jp: 新入社員は何かと不安なことが多いものだ。
example.en: New employees tend to have many worries in one way or another.

meaning_vi: Chuyện gì cũng, chuyện này chuyện kia
meaning_en: this and that, one thing and another

example.jp: 何だかんだ言っても、結局は仲のいい二人だ。
example.en: Whatever they say, those two are ultimately on good terms.

example.jp: なぜか今日は朝からずっと元気が出ない。
example.en: For some reason, I've had no energy since this morning.

example.jp: 何だか胸騒ぎがして、落ち着かない気分だ。
example.en: I have some kind of uneasy feeling and can't seem to calm down.

example.jp: 何しろ初めての経験だから、不安なのは仕方ない。
example.en: After all, it's my first experience, so being anxious is understandable.

example.jp: 彼女の言葉が正しいかどうか、何とも言えない。
example.en: I really can't say whether her words are correct or not.

example.jp: どうかご無事でいてくださいと、祈っていました。
example.en: I was praying that you would please be safe.

meaning_vi: Bằng cách nào đó, cuối cùng rồi cũng

example.jp: 締め切りには間に合わないと思ったが、どうにか終わった。
example.en: I thought I wouldn't make the deadline, but I somehow managed to finish.

meaning_vi: Bằng mọi giá, nhất định, làm cách nào cũng (không thể)
meaning_en: by all means, at any cost

example.jp: どうしてもその映画が見たくて、遠くまで行った。
example.en: I wanted to see that movie so badly that I went all the way there.

meaning_en: anyway, at any rate, after all

example.jp: どうせ間に合わないなら、焦っても仕方がない。
example.en: If we're not going to make it anyway, there's no point in rushing.

example.jp: どうやら彼は事情を知っているようだ。
example.en: It seems like he knows the circumstances.

meaning_vi: Tóm lại, nói chung, dù thế nào

example.jp: とにかく今は、目の前のことに集中しよう。
example.en: Anyway, for now let's concentrate on what's right in front of us.

example.jp: この量はとても一人では食べきれない。
example.en: There is absolutely no way one person can finish this amount.

example.jp: 電車で行くより、歩いた方が早いかもしれない。
example.en: It might be faster to walk than to go by train.

meaning_vi: Như thế nào, biết bao nhiêu

example.jp: 彼がいかに努力したかは、結果を見れば分かる。
example.en: You can tell how hard he worked just by looking at the results.

example.jp: 彼の説明はいかにも本当らしくて、みんなが信じた。
example.en: His explanation sounded so convincingly true that everyone believed him.

example.jp: 遅くまで残業した。それで今日は疲れているんだ。
example.en: I worked overtime until late. That's why I'm tired today.

example.jp: 問題が発生した。そこで上司に相談することにした。
example.en: A problem came up. So I decided to consult my boss.

example.jp: ドアを開けた。すると、見知らぬ人が立っていた。
example.en: I opened the door. Then, a stranger was standing there.

example.jp: 彼は会議に欠席した。なぜなら急病だったからだ。
example.en: He was absent from the meeting. The reason is that he suddenly fell ill.

example.jp: 今日は早退します。というのも、子どもが熱を出したんです。
example.en: I'm leaving early today. The thing is, my child has a fever.

meaning_en: in other words, that is to say

example.jp: 彼は一切返事をしなかった。つまり、拒否ということだ。
example.en: He gave no reply at all. In other words, it means refusal.

example.jp: 彼女はいわゆる「天才」というタイプの人間だ。
example.en: She is what you would call a "genius" type of person.

example.jp: 今日は遅刻した。その上、大事な書類も忘れた。
example.en: I was late today. On top of that, I also forgot an important document.

example.jp: 彼は遅刻した。そればかりか、謝りもしなかった。
example.en: He was late. Not only that, he didn't even apologize.

example.jp: この店は安い。しかも、料理がとても美味しい。
example.en: This restaurant is cheap. Moreover, the food is very delicious.

example.jp: 彼女はピアノが弾ける。また、歌も上手だ。
example.en: She can play the piano. Also, she is a good singer.

example.jp: 毎日練習した。しかし、試合には負けてしまった。
example.en: I practiced every day. However, I ended up losing the match.

example.jp: 勝てると思っていた。ところが、あっさり負けた。
example.en: I thought I would win. But to my surprise, I lost easily.

seg.t: っていた。ところが、あっさり

example.jp: 雨が降っていた。それでも、彼は走り続けた。
example.en: It was raining. Even so, he kept on running.

example.jp: 体調が悪かった。それにもかかわらず、試験を受けた。
example.en: My health was poor. Nevertheless, I took the exam.

seg.t: かった。それにもかかわらず、

seg.t: すべきだ。そうはいっても、

example.en: He said he was a beginner. Even so, he's too skilled for that.

example.jp: 兄は理系が得意だ。一方、妹は文系が向いている。
example.en: My older brother is good at science. On the other hand, my younger sister suits the humanities.

example.jp: この仕事は楽しい。ただ、給料が少し低い。
example.en: This job is enjoyable. It's just that the pay is a bit low.

example.jp: 参加は無料です。ただし、事前予約が必要です。
example.en: Participation is free. However, advance reservation is required.

meaning_vi: Ngoài ra, hơn nữa, trái lại

example.jp: 明日の会議は10時からです。なお、場所は3階です。
example.en: Tomorrow's meeting starts at 10. Additionally, the location is on the 3rd floor.

example.jp: メールまたは電話でご連絡ください。
example.en: Please contact us by email or phone.

example.jp: コーヒーになさいますか。それとも、紅茶がよろしいですか。
example.en: Will you have coffee, or would you prefer tea?

seg.t: コーヒーになさいますか。それとも、

example.en: Today was fun, wasn't it. By the way, when is the next plan?

example.jp: 準備はできましたか。さて、そろそろ始めましょう。
example.en: Are you ready? Well then, let's get started.

seg.t: はできましたか。さて、そろそろ

meaning_en: then, well then, in that case

example.en: Everyone is here. In that case, let us begin the meeting.

seg.t: そろいましたね。それでは、
